note: 32px floor tile = 2x2 game tiles. Pixels unchanged from approved mock-up.

floor.rules: v0.0.48 step35b soft cracked stone (VH approved option B). Random pick by weight, random flipX OK; accents (10-12) never touch another accent. Old v0.0.44 sheet burningG_floor_variants_32px.png kept for HellordTuning.burningFloorV48 = false.

wall_cap.rules: north wall cap row: cycle cap_S, cap_S_alt1, cap_S_alt2

wall_north_face.rules: north wall 48px = cap row (16) + face (32). Accents are harmless decor, no collision change. All faces share one brick-row grid so any order tiles.

wall_ao.rules: shadow strip under north wall and inside side walls, alpha, drawn over floor

lava_pieces.placement: top-left on the 32px floor grid; transparent decal drawn over any floor tile, sorted under sprites
join_rules: Pieces connect only at the middle of a tile edge: rows/cols 14-18 (5px wide), identical on every piece, so any matching pair is seamless.
Name = sides it connects: H = W+E, V = N+S, bend_X_Y = sides X and Y, end_X = connects on side X only and fades out inside the tile.
Every open side must face a piece with the opposite side (W<->E, N<->S); finish every crack with end pieces.
All pieces of one crack must share the same state and frame index (one crack = one animator).

asleep.look: warm dark crust, no glow, harmless

lava_states.cycle: asleep -> wake_tell -> active (loop for hazard duration) -> cooldown -> asleep

pulse_offsets.rule: each crack starts its active loop at a different frame so cracks don't pulse in step: frame = (loop_index + offset) % 6
pulse_offsets.runtime_pieces: pick offset 0-5 per crack (random or by crack id)

layouts.note: pre-baked example cracks, 10 frames left->right in the same column order as lava_pieces, pulse offset already baked in
